date-duration-calculator.name: Date Duration Calculator
date-duration-calculator.description: Calculate calendar days, weeks and business days between dates, excluding weekends and your own holidays.

meta.title: Date Duration Calculator
meta.description: Calculate calendar days, weeks and business days between dates, excluding weekends and your own holidays.
meta.keywords: date duration calculator, date difference, business days, working days, holidays

dateDuration.hint: Use Gregorian dates from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31. Dates have no time zone, so daylight saving does not affect the result.
dateDuration.inclusive: Count both the start and end dates.
dateDuration.exclusive: Count the start date; exclude the end date. Equal dates give 0 days.
dateDuration.holidayHint: One YYYY-MM-DD date per line, up to {limit} lines (120,000 characters). Blank lines are ignored. Duplicate, weekend and out-of-range holidays are not deducted twice.
dateDuration.emptyResult: Enter two dates and calculate to see the result.
dateDuration.businessHint: Business days are Monday–Friday minus the supplied holidays. Public holidays are not loaded automatically; substitute working weekends are not included.
dateDuration.invalidDate: {field} must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date between years 0001 and 9999.
dateDuration.reversed: End date must be on or after start date.
dateDuration.invalidHoliday: Holiday on line {line} is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date (years 0001–9999).
dateDuration.holidayLimit: Use at most {limit} holiday lines and 120,000 characters.
